# Kleos Research — expanded context

Kleos Research is an AI research lab. Its work focuses on the harness layer between a person and a model: what enters context, what persists across sessions and tools, and the total cost of completing useful work.

## Kaleidoscope

Kaleidoscope is local memory for AI agents. It preserves accepted decisions, preferences, constraints, corrections, procedures, relationships, and outcomes across harnesses without moving the memory algorithm into public SDK code.

The developer surface consists of:

- a `kscope` native CLI and persistent stdio MCP server;
- exactly two model-facing MCP tools: `search` and `remember`;
- an npm package named `@kleos-research/kaleidoscope`; and
- integrations for Codex, Claude Code and SDK, Cursor, OpenCode, LangChain, LangGraph, OpenAI Agents SDK, CrewAI, and generic MCP clients.

The npm package contains the `kscope` command and a launcher that picks the binary for your platform. A platform package carries the proprietary engine as source-free native object code, built for macOS and Linux, on arm64 and x86_64. There is no Python package.

Kaleidoscope is published on npm (`npm install -g @kleos-research/kaleidoscope`) and needs a key to run; email contact@kleosresearch.xyz for one. Nothing is signed for release yet, and the product terms are reviewed drafts that are not yet in force. The documentation's status page, https://memory.kleosresearch.xyz/status/, says what has been run and on which machines.

## 0xCopilot

0xCopilot is a local-first desktop agent. It plans work across files and connected tools and pauses for approval before consequential external actions. Product information is at https://copilot.kleosresearch.xyz/.

## Research and organization

Kleos publishes papers, reports, specifications, protocols, and notes at https://kleosresearch.xyz/research/. Organization repositories are at https://github.com/kleos-research. Contact: contact@kleosresearch.xyz.
